conclusion: All six acceptance criteria are met within their explicit interim scope; no high-severity finding or waived AC. Final concerns are environment reproducibility and inherited accessibility coverage, with owners and successor placement.
independence: Reviewer made no product/test-source edits, no Gradle/runner build or fixture execution, no commits, no external writes. Existing green whole-wave gates were inspected rather than repeated. QA-only production build and five targeted FE files closed concrete evidence gaps.

Negative-control evidence confirms missing-handler and stale-A/C failures, without counting filtered skips.

AC-6.given_when_then: Given baseline and final evidence, when test names are reconciled and final gates are checked, 854 - 216 + 57 + 4 = 699 story tests; two preserved unrelated hook tests make 701 total, and final-source type-check, lint, production build and full vitest succeed.
AC-6.detail: Initial removed/added name sets exactly equal the ledger; five baseline unloadable suites are explicitly not counted. QA independently ran production build and 126 targeted tests without skips. S4c ran all 56 FE files including all 7 WCAG cases. The final S4c log has per-file counts rather than per-case JSON; every file/count matches the UX name set plus the two hook names.
